title: Forensic Consultant
description:
Forensic Consultant

**Forensic Consultant**

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a skilled and proactive
**Forensic Consultant**
to lead and execute complex digital forensic investigations. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in forensic acquisition, analysis, and reporting, and will play a key role in mentoring junior analysts, refining methodologies, and contributing to strategic initiatives within the forensics team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead comprehensive digital forensic investigations across various platforms (computers, mobile devices, servers, cloud environments).
* Perform forensic imaging, data recovery, metadata analysis, and timeline reconstruction using advanced tools (e.g., EnCase, FTK, X-Ways, Cellebrite, Magnet AXIOM).
* Guide incident response efforts by analyzing attack vectors, data exfiltration, and unauthorized access trails.
* Produce high-quality, defensible forensic reports suitable for legal proceedings, compliance audits, and corporate investigations.
* Provide expert-level consultation to clients, internal teams, or law enforcement on digital evidence handling and interpretation.
* Mentor junior analysts, review casework, and contribute to training and quality assurance efforts.
* Maintain chain-of-custody documentation and adhere to legal standards in evidence handling.
* Research and implement emerging forensic tools, techniques, and threat trends to enhance investigative capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in digital Forensics, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field.
* Industry certifications such as EnCE, CCE, CHFI, or equivalent are highly preferred.
* In-depth knowledge of forensic principles, evidence handling, and digital investigation workflows.
* Proficient with forensic tools and scripting languages (Python, PowerShell) for automation and data parsing.
* Strong understanding of operating systems, file systems, networking, and cloud environments.
* Familiarity with legal, regulatory, and compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, etc.).

**Experience**

* 2–3 years of professional experience in digital forensics, preferably in a consulting, corporate, or law enforcement setting.
* Proven track record of independently managing investigations from intake through final reporting.
* Experience presenting technical findings to legal, executive, or non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in memory forensics, mobile device analysis, or reverse engineering.
* Knowledge of threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Exposure to tools such as Volatility, YARA, or network traffic analysis platforms.
* Experience serving as an expert witness or supporting litigation/eDiscovery teams.

**Why Join Us?**

* Take the lead on impactful investigations with national and international clients.
* Collaborate with a highly skilled, mission-driven team.
* Access cutting-edge tools and resources.
* Continuous learning, certification support, and career advancement.
* Flexible and collaborative work culture.

Location

Ahmedabad

Experience

Mid-Level (2–3 Years)

Job Type

Full-time

Department

Cyber Forensics & Investigations

title: QA Lead
description:
**Description:**

* Check the live platform twice a day (login, dashboards, device data, alerts, reports, APIs) and escalate critical (P0/P1) issues within 30 minutes.
* Own the go/no-go sign-off for every release, both cloud and on-premise.
* Write detailed test cases from product documents and PRDs, covering positive, negative, boundary and user- permission scenarios, and keep every requirement linked to a test case.
* Validate client compliance reports clause by clause against the live software, with evidence (screenshots, videos, logs).
* Run security tests on web apps and APIs based on the OWASP Top 10: login and access control, IDOR, input validation and direct API testing. Track vulnerabilities by severity and support external VAPT audits.
* Build and maintain automated smoke and regression tests (UI and API) that run in the CI/CD pipeline before every release.
* Test across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, major browsers, and screen sizes from laptop to 4K.
* Track page load time, API response time and memory use per release.
* Test data accuracy end to end, from device to cloud to dashboard, including missing data, duplicates and timestamps.
* Log bugs with clear severity (P0–P3), verify fixes, run root-cause analysis on escaped bugs, and maintain a QA dashboard.
* Guide and review the work of 1–2 QA engineers, and maintain QA process documents (SOPs).
* Use AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code) to speed up test scripts, test case writing and log analysis.

**What we're looking for**

* 3–4 years in software QA, with at least 2 years on enterprise web or SaaS applications.
* Strong test case design and test planning, including requirement-to-test traceability.
* Hands-on experience with at least one UI automation framework (e.g. Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and
* one API testing tool (e.g. Postman).
* Working knowledge of security testing: OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorization, API security.
* Experience with load or performance testing tools (e.g. k6 or JMeter) and browser DevTools (Network, Console, Lighthouse).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git and basic SQL for data checks.
* Experience with bug tracking tools such as Jira, ClickUp or Linear.
* Clear written communication for bug reports, test reports and compliance evidence.

**Nice to have**

* Experience testing IoT or real-time data platforms (MQTT, device-to-cloud data).
* Exposure to VAPT, SOC 2 or ISO 27001 processes.
* Experience testing on-premise installs, including upgrades and rollbacks.
* Experience mentoring junior testers.
* Hands-on use of AI coding agents in QA work.

Salary : up to 8 LPA

For more details please share your resume on prutha@postaresume.co.in or call on 9328361089

title: Associate Manager - Network Security
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Network & Cloud Cybersecurity Specialist is responsible for securing cloud and network environments, mitigating cyber threats, and ensuring compliance with security frameworks. This role focuses on threat detection, incident response, and implementing best practices to protect enterprise infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Network & Cloud CyberSecurity Specialist**
**Network Security Tools And Technologies Management**
Configuration and management of network security tools (e.g., firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, network monitoring platforms, proxy, NAC etc).
  
  
Ensure network security technologies are properly tuned, updated, and optimized to detect and prevent security incidents.
  
  
**Network Security Operations Management**
Manage the day-to-day operations of the network security team, ensuring effective monitoring, detection, and response to network security incidents.
  
  
Ensure that network security controls (e.g., firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, network monitoring tools) are deployed and optimized to protect the organization’s infrastructure.
  
  
Establish and lead a proactive approach to identifying and addressing emerging network threats, vulnerabilities, and attack patterns.
  
  
**Incident Response And Risk Management**
Assist organization’s network incident response plan, ensuring rapid identification, containment, and mitigation of security incidents and breaches.
  
  
Lead root cause analysis of network security incidents, ensuring lessons learned are applied to enhance security measures.
  
  
Conduct risk assessments of network systems and lead efforts to implement appropriate risk mitigation strategies and controls.
  
  
**Cloud Security & Zero Trust**
Implement and oversee cloud security controls and cloud firewalls.
  
  
Support Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) strategies, ensuring robust authentication, authorization, and micro-segmentation.
  
  
Manage privileged access controls and enforce security policies to mitigate insider threats and external risks.
  
  
**Collaboration With Cross-Functional Teams**
Partner with other departments, such as IT, compliance, legal, and risk management, to ensure alignment of network security strategies with broader organizational objectives.
  
  
Work closely with senior executives to provide updates on network security risks and vulnerabilities, offering recommendations for improvement.
  
  
Collaborate with other cybersecurity leaders to develop a cohesive, integrated approach to security across the enterprise.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement And Innovation**
Stay informed on the latest network security trends, technologies, and emerging threats to ensure the organization is protected from evolving risks.
  
  
Drive the evaluation and implementation of new network security technologies and tools to enhance the organization’s cybersecurity capabilities.
  
  
Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the network security operations team by encouraging innovation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Regulatory Compliance**
Ensure that network security operations adhere to relevant compliance requirements, ISO 27001
  
  
Oversee internal and external audits related to network security, ensuring all necessary documentation and evidence are provided.
  
  
Maintain a strong understanding of global regulatory trends and ensure that network security practices meet the highest industry standards.
  
  
**Network Security Reporting And Documentation**
Prepare and deliver regular reports to executive leadership on the health of the network security program, including threat intelligence, incident status, risk assessments, and compliance status.
  
  
Ensure that network security processes and configurations are documented clearly and kept up to date.
  
  
Maintain and manage key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to track the effectiveness of network security initiatives.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Department Heads
  
  
Internal Auditors
  
  
Risk Management Team
  
  
Cybersecurity & IT Infrastructure Team
  
  
Cloud & Network Engineering Team
  
  
Risk & Compliance Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Cloud Service Providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  
  
Security Auditors & Consultants
  
  
External Auditors
  
  
External Security Consultants
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  
  
Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA) in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a relevant discipline is highly desirable.
  
  
**Certification**
Certifications :
  
  
CEH, AWS/Azure Security Specialty, Cisco CCNP Security, Checkpoint, paloalto certificates.
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
5+ years in network security, cloud security, and cybersecurity operations.

This role involves implementing, configuring, and maintaining identity management systems and ensuring secure, compliant, and efficient management of user identities, authentication, and authorization processes. The IDAM Specialist will work to ensure that only authorized users have appropriate access to the organization's systems and data, while supporting efforts to improve and optimize the identity management processes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**IDAM Specialist**
**Identity Lifecycle Management**
Support the administration of identity lifecycle processes, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, and access reviews.
  
  
Implement role-based access control (RBAC), user provisioning policies, and workflows across applications and systems.
  
  
Assist in maintaining an accurate inventory of user identities and associated access rights across the enterprise.
  
  
**Authentication And Authorization Management**
Implement and manage authentication mechanisms such as Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Single Sign-On (SSO), and other access controls.
  
  
Assist with configuring and managing federated identity management solutions, ensuring smooth integration with cloud and on-premises applications.
  
  
Ensure that proper access control mechanisms are in place to provide secure, role-appropriate access to critical systems and data.
  
  
**IAM Tool Support And Maintenance**
Assist in the configuration, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, including tools like Okta, Microsoft Azure Active Directory, SailPoint, or similar.
  
  
Provide technical support for IAM tools and applications, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating with vendors for escalated issues.
  
  
Perform regular system health checks, ensuring IAM tools and systems are performing optimally.
  
  
**Access Reviews And Compliance**
Conduct regular access reviews to ensure compliance with the principle of least privilege and internal security policies.
  
  
Assist in ensuring that identity and access management practices are in compliance with relevant regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOX).
  
  
Prepare reports on user access and permissions for internal audits and compliance requirements.
  
  
**Incident Response And Support**
Assist in investigating and remediating incidents related to identity and access management, such as unauthorized access, privilege escalation, and account compromise.
  
  
Support the resolution of identity-related security incidents, escalating as needed to senior security staff or incident response teams.
  
  
Monitor logs and user activity for anomalous behavior, ensuring that any incidents are reported and addressed promptly.
  
  
**Policy And Process Support**
Assist in the development, implementation, and enforcement of identity management policies, including user access management, authentication protocols, and access control rules.

**Collaboration And Stakeholder Communication**
Work closely with IT, HR, compliance, and application teams to understand their requirements and ensure appropriate identity and access controls are in place.
  
  
Provide support and guidance to internal teams regarding identity management processes and policies.

Contribute to the ongoing improvement of identity and access management processes and tools to enhance efficiency, security, and user experience.

title: Server Patch & Vulnerability Remediation Engineer
description:
**Role Description**
**Position Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Server Patch \& Vulnerability Remediation Engineer to join our centralized Patch Management team.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, prioritizing, and remediating security vulnerabilities across Windows and Unix server environments. This role requires strong operating system administration skills, hands\-on experience with vulnerability remediation, knowledge of third\-party and open\-source software vulnerabilities, and the ability to develop, test, and deploy automated remediation solutions.
   

  

 The engineer will work closely with application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, and software vendors to ensure vulnerabilities are addressed within established remediation timelines while maintaining system stability, availability, and compliance with organizational security standards. Key Responsibilities
 **Required Qualifications** 
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Windows and Unix Operating System Administration
* Strong hands\-on experience administering Windows Server and Unix/Linux operating systems.
* Knowledge of Group Policy Objects (GPOs), shared file systems, user and access management, software installation, configuration, and system administration.
* Ability to troubleshoot operating system, application, and patch installation issues.
* Understanding of server dependencies, system services, permissions, and configurations that may affect patch deployment and remediation.
* Experience supporting enterprise server environments and performing security updates with minimal operational disruption.
* Vulnerability Analysis and Third\-Party Software Remediation
* Experience investigating vulnerabilities identified through Software Composition Analysis (SCA), software scanning, and vulnerability assessment tools.
* Ability to analyze vulnerability findings affecting operating systems, third\-party applications, open\-source components, and installed software.
* Knowledge of software installation paths, package dependencies, vulnerable libraries, application versions, and other factors required to determine the root cause of vulnerabilities.
* Ability to identify appropriate remediation options, including vendor patches, software upgrades, configuration changes, component replacement, or removal of vulnerable software.
* Experience coordinating with software vendors, opening support cases, reviewing release notes, validating remediation recommendations, and implementing tested solutions.
* Ability to develop remediation plans and coordinate with application and infrastructure owners to complete remediation within SLAs.
* Scripting, Automation, and BigFix
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, shell scripting, and other relevant automation technologies.
* Hands\-on experience with BigFix or similar enterprise patch management platforms.
* Ability to develop, test, and maintain automation scripts for vulnerability remediation, patch deployment, software upgrades, and compliance validation.
* Experience automating repetitive operational activities to improve remediation efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
* Ability to troubleshoot failed deployments and automate post\-remediation verification wherever feasible.
* Application Packaging and Software Deployment
* Knowledge of application packaging, software installation, configuration, and deployment processes is a plus.
* Experience preparing, testing, and deploying third\-party and open\-source software updates across enterprise server environments.
* Ability to analyze application installation requirements, dependencies, compatibility considerations, and potential operational impacts.
* Understanding of software versioning, package management, installation parameters, and silent installation techniques.
* Experience with BigFix or similar tools for software distribution and deployment is desirable.
* Vulnerability Remediation, Change Management, and Troubleshooting
* Experience executing security patching and vulnerability remediation activities across enterprise server environments.
* Ability to prioritize remediation based on vulnerability severity, exploitability, asset criticality, and organizational remediation timelines.
* Knowledge of change management processes, maintenance windows, implementation plans, rollback procedures, and post\-deployment validation.
* Ability to investigate failed patches, installation errors, application compatibility issues, and other remediation blockers.
* Experience coordinating with application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, and other stakeholders to resolve remediation challenges.
* Ability to maintain accurate remediation records, provide status updates, and support security compliance and audit reporting.
* Analyze vulnerability and software scanning findings affecting Windows and Unix/Linux servers.
* Investigate reported vulnerabilities to determine the affected software, installation locations, vulnerable components, and appropriate remediation approach.
* Develop and execute remediation plans for operating system, third\-party, and open\-source software vulnerabilities.
* Identify applicable vendor fixes, security updates, software upgrades, and alternative treatment options.
* Coordinate with software vendors and application owners to obtain remediation guidance and resolve technical dependencies.
* Test patches and software updates in non\-production environments, validate results, and coordinate production deployment through approved change management processes.
* Develop and maintain PowerShell, shell, and BigFix automation to improve patch deployment and vulnerability remediation efficiency.
* Troubleshoot patch failures, software installation issues, compatibility problems, and post\-deployment incidents.
* Perform post\-remediation validation to confirm that vulnerabilities have been addressed and systems remain operational.
* Track remediation progress, maintain evidence, document exceptions and blockers, and provide accurate status updates to management and security stakeholders.
* Partner with infrastructure, application, security, and operations teams to meet remediation SLAs and maintain compliance with organizational security requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve patching processes, automation, deployment reliability, and overall vulnerability remediation effectiveness.
* Relevant experience in Windows and Unix/Linux server administration, enterprise patch management, vulnerability remediation, or infrastructure operations.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working in a large enterprise IT environment with established change management and security compliance requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across technical teams and application stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple remediation activities and meet defined deadlines in a fast\-paced operational environment.
* Hands\-on experience with BigFix for patch management, software deployment, and automation.
* Experience with vulnerability assessment and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools such as Qualys or equivalent platforms.
* Knowledge of security advisories, CVEs, vulnerable software components, and vendor remediation guidance.
* Experience with application packaging and third\-party software lifecycle management.
* Familiarity with enterprise vulnerability management processes, remediation SLAs, and security compliance requirements.


**Skills**
 UNIX, BigFix, Patch Management, Vulnerability Management

title: Senior Patch & Vulnerability Remediation Engineer
description:
**Role Description**
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a Senior Patch \& Vulnerability Remediation Engineer with strong experience in vulnerability management, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), enterprise patching, SCCM/MECM, PowerShell, and remote remediation. The role focuses on identifying, assessing, prioritizing, remediating, and validating vulnerabilities across enterprise workstations, servers, applications, and software components.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform end\-to\-end vulnerability assessment workflows including scanning, analysis, classification, prioritization, remediation, validation, and closure.
* Analyze vulnerability scan and SCA results, including CVEs, affected software/dependencies, severity, exploitability, and business impact.
* Perform Software Composition Analysis (SCA) and coordinate remediation of open\-source and third\-party software vulnerabilities.
* Develop and execute vulnerability remediation and patching plans within defined SLAs.
* Research vendor advisories, patches, fixes, and remediation guidance.
* Test, deploy, and validate OS and application security patches across workstations and servers.
* Use SCCM/MECM for patch deployment, compliance monitoring, software distribution, and endpoint management.
* Perform SCCM/MECM troubleshooting, including deployment failures, client issues, content/download problems, and compliance discrepancies.
* Perform remote remediation and troubleshooting across enterprise endpoints and servers.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for remediation, automation, validation, inventory, and troubleshooting.
* Perform log analysis to investigate patch, deployment, endpoint, and remediation failures.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
* Validate remediation through follow\-up vulnerability scans, compliance checks, and endpoint validation.
* Support urgent remediation of critical and zero\-day vulnerabilities.
* Maintain remediation tracking, SLA metrics, compliance reports, and remediation evidence.
* Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure, Application Support, Endpoint Management, and vendor teams.


**Mandatory Skills**
* Software Composition Analysis (SCA)
* Vulnerability Assessment \& Remediation
* Vulnerability Scanning
* Enterprise Patching
* SCCM / MECM
* SCCM/MECM Troubleshooting
* PowerShell Scripting
* Log Analysis
* Remote Remediation
* Vulnerability Assessment Workflows
* CVE/CVSS and vulnerability prioritization
* Patch compliance and remediation validation
* Windows workstation/server environments


**Experience**
* 5\+ years in vulnerability management, patch management, endpoint engineering, or infrastructure security.
* Hands\-on experience with SCA, vulnerability remediation, SCCM/MECM, PowerShell, patching, and remote troubleshooting.
* Experience with tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, Nessus, Snyk, Black Duck, Mend, or Sonatype is preferred.


**Skills**
 Software Composition Analysis (SCA), Vulnerability Remediation, Vulnerability Scanning, Patching, SCCM/ MECM

title: Senior Application Security Manager
description:
**Responsibilities** 




**This is a strategic leadership position responsible for driving the Group’s application security vision and embedding security across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). The role will focus on strengthening secure design practices, DevSecOps integration, vulnerability management, and ensuring that applications across the enterprise are resilient against evolving cyber threats.** 




  





**The incumbent will work closely with engineering, digital, and product teams to establish scalable security frameworks, promote secure coding practices, and enable a proactive, risk\-based approach to application security.** 




  




* **Preside over monthly meetings with the GCISO,GCIO, BU CIOs and COEs with the agenda to improve posture of the organization, enhance IT security performance, promote collaboration \& community building.**
* **This Position reports into the GCISO**



  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Education Qualification** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* Master's degree in Cybersecurity or relevant field (preferred)



**Certification Required (preferred)** 



* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP)
* Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
* Any other relevant cybersecurity certifications



  





**Experience** 



* **15 years of experience in the cybersecurity industry with strong experience in application security.**
* **Demonstrated expertise in application security baselining assessment (SAST/DAST) and DevSecOps.**

title: Head OT - Cyber Security
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 The Head OT Cybersecurity is responsible for overseeing and leading the organization’s operational technology (OT) cybersecurity strategy, ensuring the security and integrity of critical infrastructure, industrial control systems (ICS), and operational environments. This senior leadership role will drive the development, implementation, and maintenance of OT cybersecurity policies, standards, and practices to protect OT assets from cyber threats. The Head OT Cybersecurity will also oversee incident response, risk management, and compliance efforts while collaborating with cross\-functional teams to secure the organization’s OT environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Head OT Cybersecurity**
**OT Cybersecurity Strategy Development**
 Lead the development and execution of the organization’s OT cybersecurity strategy, ensuring alignment with overall cybersecurity and business goals.
   

  

 Establish a comprehensive OT cybersecurity framework that includes policies, procedures, and controls to safeguard critical infrastructure.
   

  

 Continuously monitor industry trends, emerging threats, and regulatory changes to adapt and evolve OT cybersecurity strategies.
   

  

**Risk Management And Vulnerability Assessment**
 Oversee risk assessments, vulnerability management, and threat modeling for OT systems, ensuring that all risks are properly identified, analyzed, and mitigated.
   

  

 Develop and implement risk mitigation plans based on vulnerability assessments and threat intelligence specific to OT systems.
   

  

 Monitor OT system configurations and identify opportunities to strengthen security postures, reducing exposure to cyber threats.
   

  

**Incident Response And Recovery**
 Lead OT cybersecurity incident response efforts, coordinating detection, containment, investigation, and recovery from OT\-related security incidents and breaches.
   

  

 Develop and implement incident response plans tailored to OT environments, addressing the unique characteristics of industrial control systems.
   

  

 Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external agencies to investigate and resolve cybersecurity incidents, ensuring minimal impact on operations.
   

  

**Compliance And Regulatory Oversight**
 Ensure OT cybersecurity policies and practices comply with relevant industry standards, regulations, and frameworks (e.g., NIST SP 800\-82, IEC 62443, NERC CIP, GDPR).
   

  

 Lead efforts to maintain OT cybersecurity compliance during audits, assessments, and inspections.
   

  

 Stay up to date with industry regulatory requirements and ensure timely adaptation of OT cybersecurity practices.
   

  

**Security Architecture And Technology Management**
 Design, implement, and oversee the deployment of security architecture for OT systems, including network segmentation, firewalls, access control, and endpoint security.
   

  

 Work closely with the IT department to integrate OT cybersecurity measures with broader enterprise security systems.
   

  

 Evaluate, recommend, and deploy new security technologies to enhance the security posture of OT environments, such as intrusion detection systems (IDS) and security information and event management (SIEM) systems.
   

  

**Collaboration With Cross\-Functional Teams**
 Collaborate with IT, operations, engineering, legal, compliance, and executive leadership to ensure OT cybersecurity initiatives align with organizational priorities.
   

  

 Engage with external partners, including third\-party vendors and regulatory bodies, to maintain the security and compliance of OT systems.
   

  

 Ensure the secure integration of third\-party OT devices and systems into the organization’s environment.
   

  

**Leadership And Team Management**
 Lead and mentor a team of cybersecurity professionals focused on OT, ensuring high performance and professional development.
   

  

 Manage OT cybersecurity staff, setting clear objectives, providing regular feedback, and ensuring alignment with the broader cybersecurity team.
   

  

 Build a culture of security awareness within the OT domain, ensuring all stakeholders understand the importance of cybersecurity.
   

  

**Training And Awareness**
 Develop and implement training programs to raise cybersecurity awareness among OT personnel, ensuring they understand their role in maintaining security.
   

  

 Conduct regular OT cybersecurity drills and exercises to prepare staff for potential cybersecurity incidents.
   

  

 Provide guidance and support to OT teams in applying security best practices to operational processes.
   

  

**Continuous Improvement And Innovation**
 Foster a culture of continuous improvement by reviewing OT security incidents, analyzing root causes, and implementing improvements to prevent future occurrences.
   

  

 Stay abreast of the latest trends and technologies in OT cybersecurity and integrate cutting\-edge tools to enhance defense capabilities.
   

  

 Lead efforts to drive innovation and enhance the cybersecurity posture of the OT environment across the organization.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Executive Leadership
   

  

 Department Heads
   

  

 Legal and Compliance Teams
   

  

 OT Operations Team
   

  

 System Administrators and Operations
   

  

 Engineering and Maintenance Teams
   

  

 Procurement and Vendor Management Team
   

  

 Facilities Management
   

  

 Training Team
   

  

 Risk Management Team
   

  

 Internal Auditors
   

  

 IT Team
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Regulatory Bodies
   

  

 Industrial Control System (ICS) Vendors
   

  

 External Auditors
   

  

 Legal Advisors
   

  

 Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs)
   

  

 Compliance and Certification Bodies
   

  

 Industry Associations
   

  

 Government Agencies
   

  

 Consultants
   

  

 Incident Response Service Providers
   

  

 Third\-Party OT Solution Providers
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
   

  

 Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA) in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a relevant discipline is highly desirable.
   

  

**Certification**
 Advanced certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, GIAC GICSP, IEC62443 or other OT\-specific security certifications (e.g., Certified SCADA Security Architect) are highly desirable.
   

  

**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
 15\+ years of overall experience , with a focus on securing operational technology or industrial control systems.
   

  

 At least 5 years in a senior leadership or management role within OT cybersecurity.

**Job Purpose:** 
 Senior DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing and managing secure DevOps practices, focusing on automating processes, securing infrastructure, and optimizing workflows within a dynamic and evolving environment. They will will work closely with cross\-functional teams, ensuring the integration of security into every aspect of the DevOps lifecycle to build resilient, secure, and scalable systems.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities of Role


**Senior DevOps Engineer \- IC**
**Automation And CI/CD Optimization**
 Design, create and optimize CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, contribute to the templatization framework and make sure most pipeline code is reusable across various microservices, implementing best practices for efficiency and reliability.

 Create Terraform Modules that are reusable in various implementation Infrastructure as Code (IAC). Modules have to follow best practices and security guidelines concurred internally. Use Ansible for configuration management and automation of server setups (TSDB, PGPool, Looker VM etc.), ensuring consistency across environments.

 Implement secure containerization using tools like Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring security best practices (e.g., secure image scanning, role\-based access control).

 Work with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) to design secure cloud infrastructure, ensuring compliance with security frameworks and best practices.

 Collaborate with security teams to identify, analyze, and patch security vulnerabilities within the CI/CD pipeline and infrastructure.
   

  

**Collaboration With Development And Security Teams**
 Work closely with developers to ensure security is integrated from the beginning of the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Collaborate with cybersecurity professionals to ensure the infrastructure and applications meet compliance standards.

 Document the DevOps processes, security procedures, and compliance reports.

 IT Team
   

  

 Product Management Team
   

  

 Risk Management Teams

 Human Resources

 Cloud Service Providers
   

  

 Third\-Party Vendors \& Consultants
   

  

 Regulatory Bodies
   

  

 External Auditors
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
   

  

 Strong understanding of DevOps principles and practices.
   

  

 Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
   

  

 Knowledge of automation tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins).
   

  

 Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).
   

  

 Understanding of network protocols and security best practices.
   

  

 Significant experience in implementing and managing CI/CD pipelines.
   

  

 Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) and configuration management.
   

  

 Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
   

  

 Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
   

  

**Certification**
 AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, or other relevant certifications.
   

  

**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
 5\+ years of experience in DevOps, with at least 2 years in leading DevOps role.

**Job Purpose:**

This role works closely with various teams to integrate risk management practices into daily operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Roles and Responsibilities:**
* Manage a comprehensive DLP program, including data discovery, classification, and protection policies.
* Conduct DLP and DSPM assessments to identify, mitigate, and report data protection risks.
* Ensure compliance with data protection regulations across multiple geographies.
* Collaborate with legal teams to review contracts and MSAs for DLP compliance.
* Oversee deployment and tuning of disk encryption technologies (e.g., BitLocker).
* Understanding of Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and evaluate vendor risks from a DLP perspective.
* Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB) reviews to ensure DLP/DAM/DSPM considerations are integrated.
* Manage and respond to data breaches and DLP incidents.
* Stay up to date with the latest DLP trends, threats, and technologies.


**People Management**
* Foster an environment of learning, excellence, and innovation within the team and across teams.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members.
* Conduct performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
* Ensure continuous professional development of team members.


**Qualifications**
**Educational qualifications \& Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field.
* 10–12 years of experience in data loss prevention, data discovery/classification, and database/data security.
* Experience with DSPM tools and integration in hybrid environments.
* Familiarity with security standards and frameworks such as GDPR, ISO 27001, and NIST.
* Experience with DLP, DSPM, disk encryption tools and automation.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, or OSCP are a plus.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to stay up to date with the latest DLP trends, threats, and technologies.
